articleTitle: Fractal Dimension of the Surface Shape of Textile Patterns
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The main purpose of this research is to use the fractal dimension to analyze the characteristics of the surface shape of textile patterns. First give a brief description of the Fractal Theory is given and then, the characteristics of the surface shape of textile patterns are analysis. Based on box-counting method, an algorithm is derived to calculate the fractal dimension of the surface shape of textile patterns. Then, a computing program of the fractal dimension is developed with the help of MATLAB. Through this program, the surface shape of textile patterns is described. The results of this paper include a mathematical model to describe the observation of fractal characteristics in the surface shape of textile patterns.

articleTitle: A Novel Time Streams Prediction Approach Based on Exponential Smoothing
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: A data stream prediction algorithm using Linear Regression based on Exponential Smoothing method was proposed in this paper, namely Exponential Smoothing based Linear Regression Analysis (ES_LRA) data stream prediction algorithm. The ES_LRA algorithm only processes the current sliding window, which can improve the operation efficiency; In the meantime, it applied a Smoothing Coefficient(α) through the exponential smoothing method to smooth the estimate parameter in order to eliminate the concussion caused by unit data and increase the prediction accuracy. The experiment simulated a building fire by FDS4.0 and estimated the trend of the fume temperature. Analytical and experimental evidence show that the ES_LRA algorithm performs better both on prediction accuracy and operate efficiency.

articleTitle: A Texture-Based Method for Goods Monitoring of Video Surveillance
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Goods monitoring is an important item of video surveillance, which is necessary to run automatically in practice. Two incidents of goods monitoring including goods stolen and broken are considered in this paper. Following the process of video surveillance, a texture-based method is proposed to deal with the incidents. The main idea is to divide the image of each objective blocks into several regions equally. The texture refreshing of each region is investigated during monitoring, which means special texture status identifies the detection of goods stolen and broken. Several surveillance videos are tested, and the results indicate the proposed method and model are efficient, high detection-rate and robust. Finally, the proposed method is introduced to a intelligence video surveillance.

articleTitle: Research on Analysis of Site Selection of the University Supermarket Based on SuperMap GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The site selection of the supermarket is a complex process, and many factors are necessarily considered. The paper deals with the powerful function of spatial analysis of GIS, which is available to aid decision making for the site selection of the university supermarket. The application of spatial analysis of GIS can ensure the work of the best site selection of the supermarket. And it provides strong support for “Digital Campus Administration”.

articleTitle: An Intelligent Content-Based Routing for Multimedia Mobile Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Wireless networks will carry various multimedia applications such as voice, video and data in the future. In order to provide service quality for delay sensitive applications such as voice and video, it is necessary that mobile ad hoc networks (MANETs) support quality of service (QoS) routing in terms of bandwidth and delay. Content-based communication is a competent candidate for such dynamic networks having limited resources. This paper presents a new content-based routing approach with use of ant colony optimization for MANETs, called CARMAN. This approach exploits the behavior of ant-like agents for route discovery process. CARMAN is a simple routing protocol with autonomous traffic management and topology changes adaptation. Simulation results show the improvement in network performance by applying this method.

articleTitle: Consideration on College English Teaching Model under Information Age
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The multimedia network teaching is a new means and method for college English teaching, is also a new way to China's college English teaching reform. Constructivists believe learning is obtained by the two-way interaction of new knowledge and learners' existing knowledge. To stimulate students' interest in learning English, they emphasis on learning initiative and contextuality, student-centered, the design of the learning environment, students as learning object and teachers just playing the guiding role. College English teaching under multimedia network environment should pay attention to handling the relationship between the traditional classroom teaching and network teaching and the flexible use of teaching methods and other issues.

articleTitle: The Study of the VoIP through Firewall Security
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Today Internet is very prosperous. Network firewalls have become basic network security equipments. Not only enterprises will set up firewall system, most of SOHOs and individual users also set up a firewall as a standard device. Because public IP is not sufficient in the IPv4-based environment, so most of networks are using NAT (Network Address Translation) mechanism to translation their private IP. Thus NAT also increases the complexity of VoIP (Voice over IP) through a firewall environment. In order to allow VoIP network environment in normal operation in a firewall environment, IETF and the VoIP industry propose a lot of solution. This article is going to present some common frameworks for analysis VoIP operation and looking forward to provide VoIP normally working in a firewall network environment.

articleTitle: The Application of Data Mining Technology in the Mining Safety Management
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The safety analysis methods of the current management of traditional safety system that are the method of the fault tree analysis (FTA) and the information system of safety management (monitoring) are integrated and optimized by applying the data mining association algorithm. The new theoretical model of the management of the mining safety system is established to avoid the shortcomings that are omissions, errors, and only consider the (0, 1) state of the drawbacks of the incident existed in FTA, that improves the security management system (monitoring), empirical, passive lack of processing capacity. And the new ways are proposed to update the knowledgebase of the security system, and the evaluation of the management of the safety system is made initiative and intelligent by applying the data mining technique and the association algorithm.

articleTitle: Study on Strategic Choice between Specialized Businesses and Diversified Businesses
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Choice of business patterns between specialization and diversification, a starting point of further development, plays an essentially important role for lots of enterprises. Based on the analysis of advantages and disadvantages of specialization and diversification, a conclusion can be drawn that both specialization and diversification are effective business patterns and what matters to enterprises is to enter into the right pattern at the right time.

articleTitle: A Blind Watermarking Algorithm Based on ICA
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: A blind watermarking algorithm based on independent component analysis (ICA) is proposed. According to the human visual system (HVS) in the domain of DWT and DCT, watermark is embedded to the host image adaptively. The advantages of the multi-resolution and multi-scale of the DWT, combining with the ability of energy compression and ridding correlation of DCT make sure the robustess of the algorithm. We utilize ICA to extract the watermark without the original image. Experiment results show that the proposed algorithm enhances the watermark robustness and invisibility.

articleTitle: On the Impact of Modern Media to Teenager's Healthy Lifestyle and the Corresponding Measures
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Modern media has a universal impact on people's healthy lifestyle, and teenagers are undergoing more profound impact. TV and network and portable audio-visual media are not all of modern media, but they play a tremendous role in influence teenager's healthy lifestyle. This paper, with a view to the impact of those modern media, discusses the corresponding measures.

publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Presents the copyright information for the conference. May include reprint permission information.
