publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Conference proceedings title page.

articleTitle: Application of Virtual Simulation Technology in Practical Teaching
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The authors analyze the current situation as to vocational training, point out the problems that restricting development of vocational education in colleges. Introduce virtual simulation technology and apply it to modern practical teaching. The popularization and application will improve education quality and efficiency.

articleTitle: The Establishment of End-user Trust in Web Information Management Systems
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Lots of dishonesty actions and unreliable services flood the present applications based on Web. The paper presents an end-user trust management model for web information system by the theory of reasoned action and the technology acceptance model. In the model, the reputation of an end-user, mainly comes from other nodes' weighted trust feedback, determines whether the transaction can process or not. Moreover, the model can reduce the burden of web information system.

articleTitle: A Scheduling and Management Algorithm about Proxy Based on AFEC
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The proxy is one of the important parts of the Internet. The proxy can reduce the data flow and release the load of the servers. Because of the unpredictable problem of the network, the proxies have great influence on the video QoS. Through the perfect algorithm, within the acceptable scope, the proxy can improve the performance of the system. In the video service system, the proxy can improve the scalability of the system and improve the QoS. In this paper, a new cache replace strategy based on AFEC is proposed, which can employee the characteristics of the proxy and can improve the system performance within the normal resource.

articleTitle: Establishment and Application of the Intelligent Decision-making Simulation Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: It is one of the important targets in the institutions of higher learning that how to cultivate modern decision-making talents. It gives great impetus to realize this target that the intelligent decision-making simulation platform has been developed successfully. The platform combines all kinds of economic and management courses, which can be used in the teaching practice and develop academic activities after school. Taking advantage of the platform, students can make decision of enterprise producing management through intranet whenever and wherever. It helps to accelerate the cultivation of modern management talents and lay the foundations for the enterprises in the fierce competition to have an invincible position.

articleTitle: The Study on Finite Element Analysis for Anchor Support System Optimization
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The anchor support design is important for the design of underground engineering. The process of optimizing the anchor support design is analyzed, the finite element method is applied to it. The anchor support system is developed including fore - process, post - process, calculation of the structure and drawing by computer in order to make the designing of anchor support system more quickly, more economical and convenient. It has been applied in practice of the hydropower plant with a good result. Also, an example about a large scale hydropower plant is provided.

articleTitle: Signal Processing for Communication Based on OFDM in Power Plant
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The power plant communication system based on Orthogonal frequency division multiplexing technology was put forward, connected with communication and monitoring networks existed already, in which the cosine carriers of the conventional OFDM system are replaced by the multi-scale orthogonal wavelets transformation. In this system, wireless sensor networks or carrier transmission on low voltage power line communication is used and electric power line systems is used as broadband networks in the main lane in order to make complete signal transmission system under well. This system exploits the advantage of OFDM, such as strong anti-interference. We compared the typical wavelet basses in practical application, analyzed the effects of the orthogonal bases and its character of orthogonality, compactly supported and vanishing moments in system. This paper discussed how to select wavelet basis when we adopt the system of OFDM based on wavelet in power plant. In OFDM system, it is important to choose the wavelet bases with batter orthogonality and larger vanishing moments.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation over IEEE 802.11 Wireless LAN
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper the throughput, frame discard probability, and average frame delay performance of DCF in IEEE 802.11 are analyzed and evaluated for different parameters, such as the number of users and frame size considering the network delay and the CTS/ACK time out. Related analysis and statements will be helpful to research and development of wireless networks and products.

articleTitle: A Class of Cartesian Authentication Codes Constructed from PG(n,q)
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Let P be a point of projective space PG(n,q) (n ≥ 3 ) over field GF(q), π be a S-space through P in PG(n,q) (S ≥ 1). Let S be the source set composed of r- spaces through π (s <; r ≤ n), E be the encode rules set composed of (n- s) -spaces which intersect π at P, M be the message set composed of (r - s) -spaces which intersect π at P. For any π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>∈ S, π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> ∈ E, define f(π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub>, π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub>) = π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</sub> ∩ π<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> , we have a class of Cartesian authentication codes. We compute the parameters of these codes. Assume that the encoding rules are chosen according to a uniform probability distribution, the largest probabilities of a successful impersonation attack P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">I</sub> and the largest probabilities of a successful substitution attack P<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">S</sub> of these codes are also computed.

articleTitle: A Web-Based Job Management System Based on User Simulation Mechanism
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: As high performance computing becomes more and more prevalent, Microsoft provides a new HPC platform, Windows HPC Server 2008. Job management and job submission are key requirements in distributed computing. Users submit to clusters, manage and monitor jobs using job management system. Although Windows HPC Server provides multiple methods for job management and submission, none of them supports web-based and user-friendly interface. In this paper, we present a design and implementation of a Web-based Job Management System (WBJMS) based on user simulation mechanism for Windows HPC Server.

articleTitle: An Analysis of the Enzyme Gene and Transduction Process of Ethylene Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper mainly describes key enzymes in ethylene biosynthesis: the research progress of ACC synthase and ACC oxidase in antisense RNA technology; it is an overview of the research progress of membrane receptor and membrane signal transduction body in the ethylene signal transduction.

articleTitle: PID Parameters Tuning Method by Particle Swarm Optimization with Chaotic Disturbance
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper proposes a new PID parameter tuning method using Chaotic Particle Swarm Optimization (CPSO) with ICMIC. The method is implemented into the PID tuning of the position control system, where the transfer function represents a plant model of a servo system. The PID parameter is computed by CPSO-based, PSO-based and ZN-based PID tuning method according to the obtained model, respectively. The simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed tuning method, and are compared with the classical PSO and Ziegler-Nichols.

articleTitle: Research on the Design of Examination System with Computer
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The paper proposed the implementation methods, which is based on artificial intelligence techniques, domain knowledge of the test paper for scoring system design strategies and. Practice shows that the artificial intelligence in the production system working principle applied to the test paper and the scoring system could be well simulated person's thinking, intelligent test paper and Intelligence score.

articleTitle: One-Trip-Time based Congestion Control for Distributed Real-time Applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The traditional loss based congestion control protocol is not suitable for media streaming. because the loss based congestion control can not limit the Round Trip Time and it is also too sensitive about one side congestion, while most ADSL links which often have an asymmetric bandwidth. So in this paper, we present a novel One-Way-Trip Time based congestion control protocol, and prove its performance by simulation experiments.

articleTitle: An Exploratory Research on Resources Classification of Manufacturer in Hubei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: First, this article summarizes the classical literature of Resource-based view of the firm, demonstrates the meaning inherent in assets and competence of the firm. And then, this text uses manufacturer in Hubei province as research object, and builds a conceptual framework about firm resources. Second, this article conducts an exploratory empirical analysis on resource classification.

articleTitle: Adaptive Network Precoding Based on SJNR to Mitigate Inter-Cell Interference
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Focusing on the problem that the co-frequency interference of the downlink channels in multi-cell of multi-out multi-input (MIMO) systems, this paper used the adaptive network precoding based on the SJNR to reduce the inter-cell interference. First of all, the adaptive precoding design based on the SJNR criteria is given. In this design, each base station use independent precoding approach to suppress adjacent inter-cell interference. And then in order to decrease the handing complex by the active way, the adaptive network precoding is attained respectively in the urban and suburb area environments, two adaptive network precoding based on SJNR are obtained respectively. Simulation results show that the inter-cell interference was obviously restrained and the system performance was improved after using the active network precoding basing on the SJNR, but also reduced processing algorithms of system.

articleTitle: Study of Deep Web Sources Classification Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Searching on the Internet today can be compared to dragging a net across the surface of the ocean. While a great deal may be caught in the net, there is still a wealth of information that is deep, and therefore, missed. Deep Web sources store their content in searchable databases that only produce result dynamically in response to a direct request. In this paper, we proposed an automatic classification algorithm of Deep Web sources based on hierarchical clustering method in order to facilitate users to browse this valuable information.

articleTitle: Extraction and Application of Palm-bone Based on the Improved Active Contour Model
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The palm-bone lesion detection mainly deals with the problem of finding the position of lesion for doctors. The aim of this detection is to provide the accurate lesion data which is based on the characteristics of the edge of the hand bone of the patients to assit the patients in recovering in a short time. Since the palm-bone tends to injury, the patients will suffer a lot without the accurate diagnose and the prompt medical treatment. It has a serious influence on the patients' health. The traditional palm-bone lesion detection contains many problems in hand-wrist X-ray image such as the low contrast, unevenly lighting, by the edge of bone and muscle and soft tissue and the edge of irregular shape. The traditional edge detection method is difficult to obtain the accurate edge of the bone. This paper provides an improved active contour model to detect the edge of the palm-bone and further extraction of the image of palm-bone.

articleTitle: An Adaptive Ordering Framework for Filtering Multimedia Streams
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In multimedia stream filtering scenario, there usually exist many filtering rules that specify the filtering objectives and many filtering units that estimate the filtering rules. A filtering rule may connect to several different filtering units and a filtering unit may connect to several different filtering rules. An open problem in such a filtering scenario is how to order the filtering units in an optimal sequence so as to decrease the filtering cost. Existing methods are based on a greedy strategy which orders the filtering units according to three factors of the filtering units, i.e., the selectivity, popularity, and cost. Although all these methods reported good results, there is still one important problem that hasn't been addressed yet. The selectivity factor is set empirically, which is unable to adaptively adjust with stream passing by. Under these observations, in this paper, we propose an Adaptive ordering framework (AOF) which executes an adaptive ordering strategy. In AOF, all the temporal filtering results are preserved in each sliding window. Accordingly, the selectivity can adjust automatically and thus all the filtering units can be ordered with respect to the adapted selectivity. Experiments on both synthetic and real life multimedia streams demonstrate that our AOF method outperforms other simple filtering methods.

articleTitle: A Method for Large-Scale Terrain Rendering Based-on GPU
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a method for large-scale terrain rendering based on GPU programming. The total terrain data is partitioned into many smaller pages evenly, and the real-time scheduling for massive terrain data is realized with viewpoint-based pre-loading method and the page buffer pool management technology. With the idea of LOD algorithm, each page is divided into some sub-blocks for batch rendering, and the cracking processing between sub-blocks of different levels is advanced to the pre-processing stage, so that the real-time operation on CPU is reduced. Experience has shown that the algorithm of this paper can make CPU and GPU work more harmonious, and the efficient rendering for large-area three-dimensional terrain is realized.

articleTitle: Multimedia Case Methods in University-Based Teacher Education and Learning
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The use of cases in teacher education is not a new phenomenon, with early records of case methods dating from the beginning of the last century. However, the rapid expansion of information and computer technologies over the past decade has influenced case construction and use in profound ways. Written cases are now being integrated with video and other textual forms to create sophisticated hypermedia case environments. Hypermedia (more commonly referred to as multimedia) case platforms provide the potential to incorporate various kinds of contextual, theoretical and pedagogical information into a rich and multilayered representation of classroom teaching. In this chapter we explore the implications of these developments for teacher education and teacher learning. Factors that appeared to influence development of this motivation included student-teachers' preinstructional perspectives about science and the personalization and contextualization inherent to the modified multimedia case method.

articleTitle: Campus Internet Culture and Ideological and Political Education
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: 21st century is a networked and digitized high-technology age; the information revolution cored by Internet has entered university campus, which brings challenges and opportunities to college students' ideological and political education. Such educators should inaugurate new approaches to carry out ideological and political education according to the characteristics of net information.

articleTitle: Vision System Research of RoboCup Middle Size Robot League
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Robotic vision system has always been the focus and difficulty of the study of computer vision and digital image processing in recent years. To the problems of the vision system existing in the target location and motion tracker, the author raises a set of new vision system and proposes image processing methods of omni-directional vision and robot self-localization algorithm. Experiments show that after reconstruction, recognition speed and precision of the system are improved based on the stability, and the system is better for the contest intention.

articleTitle: The Pattern of Information System in the Scenic Spots: T-ERP and T-GIS
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This article first analyses the technical characteristics of ERP and GIS, and then proposes the concepts of T-ERP and T-GIS based on the practical situations of the management in scenic spots. It accomplishes the conceptual design and the construction of the operation patterns. This article shows that the implementation of information management in a scenic spot will improve its management efficiency and its service quality, strengthen its ability to forecast and quickly respond to emergencies, and satisfy the individual demands of tourists, especially of independent travellers, thus promote a high-level and sustainable development of the scenic spots.

articleTitle: Bottom-up Digital Music Simulation System Under Program Control
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularity of Internet applications, digital music has entered our daily life deep. Research in the field of digital music draws more attention of interested people; however, there still has no set of complete design architecture about the digital music system simulation. As a result, many people interested in digital music and programmers have difficulty to study and research in this field. This paper will describe a complete simulation process of the digital music system under program control and in an object oriented way. The article will take a bottom-up approach to describe the file structure, running process, encapsulation way, program interface, logical structure simulation and user interface of digital music system.

articleTitle: The Study of Security of Network Management Information System Based on Logistics Information Platform
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: With the popularity of logistics commerce and the development of enterprise information management technology, the application of Managements Information System based on network becomes more and more extensive. On this open condition of logistics commerce, the need of security of management information system accordingly is higher than before. The paper firstly introduces the actuality and preventing measure of the network security briefly, then presents the establishment of this network security system based on the logistics information platform, which includes visit control, transmit control and server security control etc.

articleTitle: A Study on the First Layer Assessment Variables of Logistics Quick Response Capability
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Quick Response has become a core strategy to increase competitiveness and has been widely implemented in logistics. Previously, variables affecting logistics quick response have been widely studied from the perspectives of assessment on logistics performance or supply chain performance, primarily in the USA and EU contexts. This paper analyzes the key variables to assess logistics quick response capability in China. It analyzes empirical data collected from 50 experts and professionals in logistics field to identify a hierarchy of the variables. The results indicate that, in the Chinese context, internal variables have a higher impact on logistics quick response than external ones. Moreover, variable customer service was viewed as the most important one, followed by variables of time management and logistics cost. Therefore, the study results in a first layer assessment variables which is composed of the 7 internal variables.

articleTitle: The Study on the Effectiveness for the Handoff of WiMAX and BlueTooth
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: When the client moved quickly, from WiMax into Bluetooth service coverage, then leaved the Bluetooth service coverage and accessed to another WiMax range of services. At this time, that handoff frequently in a short period of time, and decreased system efficiency, also decreased the QoS. In this research, we use NS-2 to simulate the situations. The final simulation results show that when client moving, should avoid handoff frequently. Because client from Bluetooth handover to WiMax or WiMax handover to Bluetooth frequently, that would decreased the QoS.

articleTitle: Variation Characteristics of Air Pollutant Concentrations during Typhoon Processes in Fuzhou
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The temporal and spatial distribution characteristics of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub>, SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> and the influence of meteorological conditions were analyzed based on the hourly observation data of air quality and concurrent meteorological data of 4 typhoon processes in 2005 and 2006 in Fuzhou. The results indicated that the air quality in Fuzhou during typhoon processes was better than sunny days. The concentration of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> cut down when there was heavy rain and gale. The elimination of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> was mainly affected by precipitation. The concentration of NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> increased abruptly due to the reversion of wind direction and the reduction of wind speed, higher than the concentration in sunny days of the same time. In the center of typhoon, the concentration of PM<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">10</sub> and NO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> increased for downdraft making against the diffusion of pollutants, while the concentration of SO<sub xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sub> took little change for the existence of precipitation.

articleTitle: Designing of Virtual Battlefield Operations by ABMS Method
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Agent-based modeling and simulation (ABMS) is applied to investigate a set of problems in virtual battlefield operations context. Specifically, we are working to understand the relationship between real battlefield operations practices and virtual battlefield actions. Combat task is described by means of Behavior Definition Frame, by which model of tasks allocation is established. Based on analysis on interaction process of two entity agents, organization model of agent interaction protocol by an improved Contract Net is presented. As case study, a simulator is built to realize the dynamic warfare actions simulation. The demonstration results prove that our model and approach are feasible and effective.

articleTitle: Innovations in International Finance Bilingual Education through Multimedia
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: On the basis of discussing the necessities of innovation in international finance bilingual education, this paper analyzes the feasibilities of innovation, and stresses on the innovation methods in teaching practice through multimedia.

articleTitle: Shot Boundary Detection Using Directional Empirical Mode Decomposition
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In this paper, directional empirical mode decomposition is introduced into shot boundary detection method. In the method, every frame in videos is decomposed by DEMD into a series of Intrinsic Mode Function images and a residue image. The IMF image with the lowest frequency of each frame is removed and a substitute frame is recomposed by the other IMF images and the residue image. These substitute frames are used to calculate differences of adjacent frames in order to avoid mistaken detections caused by abrupt illumination changes. A region-based object tracking method is also applied to avoid mistaken detections caused by object motions. The results of experiments show that the precision of detecting shot boundaries is significantly improved.

articleTitle: Optimal Cooperative Multi-Source Multimedia Transmission Scheduling in Peer-to-Peer Networks
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In peer-to-peer (P2P) networks, multiple sources multimedia transmission is one of the key technology in peer-to-peer (P2P) networks because of simultaneous multimedia file sharing. However, allowing all available sources to transmit to the destination node may result in serious network congestion. Thus the selection of multiple sources is one of the key issues in the design of multi-source multimedia transmission systems in P2P networks. In this paper, a cooperative multi-source sender selection scheme to minimize the multimedia distortion is proposed, based on recent advances in restless bandits algorithms. The proposed sender selection scheme has an indexability property that dramatically simplifies the computation and implementation of the policy. Furthermore, centralized control point is not necessary in the proposed scheme, and senders can join and leave from the P2P network freely. Extensive simulation results show that the proposed scheme reduces the distortion significantly compared to the existing scheme.

articleTitle: High Credible Model of Software Based on Multi-Level Fuzzy Comprehensive Evaluation Method
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: As is known to all, software system plays an important role in the information society, and high credibility is a key requirement for many types of systems, such as safety critical systems, telecommunication systems, and mission critical software systems. How to evaluate the software credibility has become an important research focus among areas of software theory and technology application. Considering these, the paper establishes a high credible model using of the multi-level fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method to evaluate the software credibility. A banking system is evaluated by the high credible evaluation model and the evaluation results prove the feasibility and effectiveness of the model.

articleTitle: MVC Model Based on High-performance Computing Operating Audit System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a review based on the MVC pattern operating systems, applications J2EE architecture, allowing users to submit job applications through the web, so that High Performance Computing Center to review the contents of the user's job to improve the safety of High Performance Computing Center.

articleTitle: The Multi-media Teaching of County-level High School in Hebei Province
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The application of multi-media in teaching attracts more and more educators' attention, but many problems of multi-media teaching and learning have still existed in many county-level high schools in Hebei province, and the concerning degree about this is relatively small. Therefore, this paper will use questionnaires and visits as the research methods to collect all aspects of information about multi-media teaching in the county-level high schools and then compare it. Hopefully, this paper can offer the schools with the information of the latest situation of multi-media teaching, and thus to facilitate the schools, the relevant departments to solve the multi-media teaching problems much better.

articleTitle: Deploying Network Architecture Scenarios with Windows Mobile
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Secure network architecture for an enterprise mobile message exchanging is very important. This paper describes three network architecture scenarios, illustrates each of the secure scenarios by showing what softwares are needed, features and consideration factors, describes varied Setup Type.

articleTitle: Study on the Real Time Log-domain Conversion for Detecting the Transient Feeble Optical Signal
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Based on the properties of transient feeble optical signal, which is the wide dynamic range and the feeble lower limit signal, it is presented a novel detecting scheme compressing signal real-time in logarithmic domain in this paper. After the principle analysis of the scheme, it has been implemented to choose appreciate parts, design the circuitry and test. The results indicated that the approach can make transient optical signal ranged 120 dB compress in the range of 0~5 V. And together with the circuitry design simplified and the dissipation decreased, the troubles at the back data acquisition module can be lessened greatly. It may be a novel clue for research on the tech of detecting the transient light and provide certain reference values to similar system design.

articleTitle: Remote Sensing Study on the Regularity of the End of Yellow River's Mouth and Coastline
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Yellow River route to the sea has changed for more than ten times since the year of 1855. Although the delta is always depositing, some time it's eroding. Especially in recent years, because the water & sand continued to reduce, the coastline of Qingshuigou eroded up to 1.45Km/year. This article first studies the change of the coastline and the end of river, then primary analyses the confulence of the water & sand condition to making land and volitity; last, discusses the function of Remote Sensing detection to Yellow River delta by utilizing the satellite Remote Sensing photography gained in 1980 combining the obtained data.

articleTitle: A Fast Deblurring Algorithm for Surveillance Scene
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper presents a new resume algorithm for video image which is disturbed by motion blur. For innovation, the new algorithm makes the denoised region of motion object as the primary target, and with the discrete model, it gets valuable result. Firstly, the method calculates the differences between the neighboring frames. Secondly, it calculates the quadrinomial moment pixel by pixel to differentiate the motion object from the background noise, with the results, it gets the region of object and abstracts the motion vector. And finally, only aiming at the object region, it uses the motion vector to accomplish the deblurring processing with the discrete model. Extensive experiments show that the new algorithm has fast processing speed, and it can reduce the disturbance of background noise, so the new algorithm improves the deblurring efficiency.

articleTitle: Motion Control System Design of Intelligent Car Based on SPCE061A
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The predecessor of robot is the intelligent remote car, which has SCM as the control core, radio-controlled car as means of communication between man and car, sensors as the car senses etc. The motion of the car determines its prospects of application and range. This paper designs hardware circuitry and software process of intelligent car based on SPCE061A SCM, realize control of motion state of intelligent remote car. The experiment shows that it has met the design requirements. It would play an extremely important role in the military, aviation, exploration and other fields.

articleTitle: Study on Actual Evaporation Changes in Area nearby Three Gorges in the Period from 1958 to 2008
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This article is based on the daily weather data during the period from January 1st 1958 to December 31st 2008 from 36 weather stations nearby Three Gorges, and gives analysis to change trend and spatial distribution change conditions of yearly average and seasonal actual evaporation in areas nearby Three Gorges before and after water storage in 2003 through MK test methods and rotated empirical orthogonal function (REOF). Study shows that: After water storage in Three Gorges reservoir in 2003, the actual evaporation in summer nearby Three Gorges area was in downward trend, particularly significant in the north part, while the actual evaporation in Spring, Autumn and Winter and annual actual evaporation in south and north parts were in obvious upward trend; Before and after dam construction, the high load sensitive area in Spring moved from north area to south area, and the central lower load value in Summer reduced from -0.35 to -0.55, the actual evaporation declined, and the high and low load values in Autumn were in spatial distribution of positive value reverse change from southwest to northeast part, and the actual evaporation is in obvious reverse change, the low and high load areas before dam construction in Winter were in rather small scope, and the change trends of evaporation in south and north parts were not obvious. The study in this article shows only observation analysis results within 5 years to date from water storage in Three Gorges Reservoir, the change of actual evaporation before and after water storage still requires long time of observation analysis statistics, and the influence on actual evaporation nearby Three Gorges needs verification with more study methods.

articleTitle: Analysis and Test Design for Development of Web Applications
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Technique for analysis models of a web application is proposed for easy and effective development. The use case diagram and web page list are generated. The page diagram and logical/physical database models are created based on the web page list and extracted data fields. Test cases for the web application are generated from call messages of the UML sequence diagram. The effectiveness of these techniques is shown using a practical case study which is a development project of a web application for Research material Management System.

articleTitle: Applying Formal Concept Analysis on Intelligent Teaching Help System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The intelligent help system (IHS) is an important assistant platform, especially in online teaching system. At present most search methods of the help systems are mainly based on keyword matches in database query or hierarchical classifications. The outstanding problem is that users are required to have a certain ability of organizing Keywords, otherwise insufficient keywords would limit the query, resulting in low recall rate and excessive keywords introduce the problem of high false negative rate and return excessive information. Our approach is founded on the Galois lattices and on the automation of Formal Concept Analysis (FCA) theory. FCA provides a conceptual tool for the analysis of data (e.g. documentation) and for the formal representation of knowledge. We compared information retrieval based on concept lattices to database queries and to navigation in hierarchical classifications and concluded that the performance of lattice navigation is better than the use of hierarchical classification in given domain.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of Linear Predictive Speech Analysis and Synthesis
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The purpose of this paper, which deals with research on the linear predictive speech analysis and synthesis system, is to provide feature analysis for the study on speaker recognition and the development of VCEA (Voice Countermeasures Effectiveness Analysis). According to this purpose, the analysis conditions and algorithms are determined. An efficient method for pitch extraction is designed.

articleTitle: Introduction and Application of Three Dimension CAD in Engineering Graphics Course
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper produces some skills and technique to solve the problem of turning 3D model solid into views of AutoCAD. Introduce 3D modeling function to engineering graphics course. Based on practice, offer some contents and elaborate how to make good use of the 3D CAD technology efficiently. Finally, according to the experiment, prove that the application is remarkable and effective. It does work in helping students make good understanding of projection and training the abstract thinking ability.

articleTitle: A Brief Study on Professional Training of Linguistic Expressive Abilities Successfully in China Based on CAI
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: China's teaching reform has witnessed great stides made in reading, writing and listening on the part of Chinese students; however, students' performance in speaking is far from satisfactory. After identifying the factors affecting oral English teaching, some strategies are put forward to improve teaching based on the author's own experience and some already-conducted research.

articleTitle: Development of the Packaging Engineering Experimental Teaching Platform Based on Interaction Design Concept
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Today is the era of information and knowledge-based economy, the task of experimental education is to train talented persons with innovative spirit and high ability, packaging engineering experimental teaching platform is to meet this demand, which is supplement and perfection to the traditional laboratory teaching. Interaction design is the basis to built the experimental teaching platform, the quality of interaction design will directly influence to the ultimate teaching effectiveness. This paper bases on elaborating the definition, characteristics and methods of interaction design, to expound and prove that it is feasibility to apply the interaction design on the experimental teaching platform. During the design of platform, the paper sums up the overall framework and the hierarchical structure of the platform based on the interaction design concept. Taking the cushion packaging materials compression test project as an example, this introduces the interaction design method to control operations using Flash software and the Action Script language.

articleTitle: An Efficient Security Hash Function in DAA
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to meet the special requirements of Direct Anonymous Attestation (DAA), this paper proposed a new security Hash Function. It follows the design principles of MD algorithm and SHA algorithm, makes full use of logic transformation and function iteration method. This algorithm can make the arbitrary length message into a hash of the message digest with 1712-bit. It is in line with the one-way, collision-resistant and other security requirements of Hash Function for DAA.

articleTitle: Two Cases of Learning Bayesian Network from Unobservable Variables
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: According differences the structure of the network and the variables, the process of learning Bayesian networks takes different forms. Generally, the variables can be observable or hidden in all or some of the data points, and the structure of the network can be known or unknown. Consequently, there are four cases of learning Bayesian networks from data: known structure and zobservable variables, unknown structure and observable variables, known structure and unobservable variables and unknown structure and unobservable variables. In this paper, we focus on known structure and unobservable variables and unknown structure and unobservable variables.

articleTitle: The Application of Multimedia-aided Instruction in the Design of Sluice
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The teaching goals can be optimized with the help of Multimedia-aided Instruction system. The Sluice Design Teaching Software is a kind of computer teaching progress which is designed according to the teaching goals of Hydraulic Engineering major as well as in the need of education. The aim that we do so is to train the students' applied ability and the ability that they can solve realistic problem with computer. This article discussed the developing goal of Sluice Design Teaching Software as well as its characteristics and advancement. This article also introduced the using method and effect of this software.

articleTitle: A Performance Evaluation of IP Mobility Support Protocols
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: At present, the number of Internet subscribers accessing Internet through mobility terminal equipment and other new types is gradually increasing, which shows it's important to develop mobility management protocols in order to provide mobility support for the subscribers. Several protocols were proposed to support IP mobility in the IETF, such as MIPv6, HMIPv6, FMIPv6 and F-HMIPv6. Some performance analyses of the protocols have been made before, most of which are about the handover and signal load, etc. However, there is lack of performance evaluation from perspective of application. In this paper, we analyze and compare the handover latency and packet transmission delay of the real time application, and also the average throughput of the non-real time application with the four IP Mobility protocols. The simulation results show that with real time application, F-HMIPv6 has the least handover latency, and the four protocols have almost the same packet transmission delay. With the non-real time application, F-HMIPv6 has the largest throughput, followed by FMIPv6 and the other protocols.

articleTitle: Multimedia Applications Systems Based on OFDM in Coal Mine
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Geology circumstance of closed environment is extremely complicated and there are many hidden trouble. In this paper, the signal sources of communication coal mine system are described in closed environment firstly, and then a kind of comprehensive information communication system based on the OFDM technology is presented. This system makes wire communication combined mutually with wireless communication by tandem adapter. Wireless communication system primarily include through-the-earth communication, inductive communication and microwaves communication system, etc Wireless communication is used in mining area or in the time of sudden accident, Power line or leaky cable is used in main lane. The technology of OFDM combines with multiple access technology and various modulations technology easily. This system makes use of the advantage of OFDM technology to provide many kinds of access service in mine. There are different grades and different rates for many consumers at the same time in these access services. The different modulation methods of sub-carries in this system increase flexibility and adaptability. The system not only fulfils the usual demand of produce communication monitoring, but also considers sudden accident, attains the state where the mining area arrives where the signal transports. System structure of the powered support' communication system and hardware design, main motion flow of the monitoring equipment were pointed out in this paper based on fully mechanized mining face in thin coal seam for complete sets of electric control equipment. From the work condition, the system can meet the requirements of the measurement and control in accuracy, real-time capacity and has high reliability.

articleTitle: Wavelet Technology and the Analysis on Fractal Properties of the Campus Network Traffic
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The fractal properties of the traffic under different scales have quite an impact on network performance. So it is important for Internet network engineering to study the traffic model which can accurately describe the singularity of the traffic under small time/space scales and the long range dependence under large time/space scales. This essay, combined with the development of the traffic study, analyzes the data of a campus network traffic based on wavelet technology, and proves the self-similarity and multi-fractal characteristics of the arriving traffic.

articleTitle: Empirical Research on Urban Rail Transit Competitiveness Judgement with F-AHP
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper sets up an analysis model of urban rail transit arrangement based on the application of Delphi and AHP and analyzes the shortcomings of analytic hierarchy process. Furthermore, this paper proposes a design of a more comprehensive and more scientific evaluation index system of urban rail transit performance assessment. The proposed system calculates every index weight using the weighting method--Gl, which is based on differential principle, It appraises comprehensive performance using fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method. Verification of the proposed system was done by conducting an experiment using the Tianjin rail transit systems to measure its performance status. Results provide the theoretical foundation for development and correction of Tianjin urban rail transit system.

articleTitle: A Quantification Method for Network Security Situational Awareness
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: After analyzing and quantifying the network security situation awareness, a quantification method for NSSA based on conditional random fields (CRFs) was proposed. Based on the positive and negative ideal comparative standards, the evaluation index elements are processed in a non-dimensional grey way, and a qualitative-quantitative evaluation method with the multilayer linear weight for the network security situation awareness is put forward. Finally, the feasibility and validity of the method are verified by analyzing some practical examples.

articleTitle: The Application of Improved Fuzzy ARTMAP Neural Network in Remote Sensing Classification of Land-use
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Land-use change is an important area of global change research, rapid and accurate access to land-use temporal and spatial variation information is a key technology to study land-use change. In this paper proposed a method which utilizes the improved model of fuzzy ARTMAP network - simplified fuzzy ARTMAP neural network for remote sensing land-use classification, and Take the TM remote sensing image of Yiwu as an example to experiment, we compared the classification results with the traditional BP neural network classification results. Tests showed that the improved ARTMAP neural network improved the Accuracy of misclassification; it also shows that the structure of the improved fuzzy ARTMAP network is simple and need less training time. The Simplified Fuzzy ARTMAP network is an effective model to deal with high dimensional remote sensing image classification.

articleTitle: Quantitative and Qualitative Forecasting Applied to Supply-Chain Inventory
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In the process of supply chain (SC) management, time inventory management problem is extremely important. In terms of academic methods, quantitative methods are very popular as the researchers could calculate the inventory if they got the historic data of some SC. However, based on quantitative methods and the results cannot too be convincible. This paper considered a supply chain system includes several kinds of products. As to the historic suppliers' demand data of this SC system, firstly we applied a quantitative forecasting analysis method to it; secondly we made a qualitative analysis to improve the complex system's inventory management performance. According to the comparison between quantitative method and the method used in this paper, we find that the accuracy is more perfect. Not only the inventory cost is lower, also the forecasting accuracy is better.

articleTitle: An Effective Algorithm for GVD Generation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The method of figuring out Generalized Voronoi Diagram (GVD) can be categorized into direct and approximated methods. The paper combines VDC (Van Der Corput) sampling sequence and an approximated method to design a GVD algorithm based on VDC sampling sequence. The algorithm improves common approximated GVD algorithm, sampling process is incremental and precision is controllable, thus current GVD algorithm performance is enhanced.

articleTitle: Study of Two Lifting Mechanisms for Tightening the Representation of MMIP
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper addresses the development of enhanced formulations for the general class of minimax mixed-integer 0-1 optimization problems using the unified optimization framework offered by the Reformulation-Linearization Technique (RLT). We also propose various Lagrangian dual formulations for the RLT-enhanced formulations. Finally, we study two general purpose lifting mechanisms for tightening the mathematical programming formulations associated with such minimax optimization problems.

articleTitle: Research of Starting Multiple Resistance Welder Machines Based on PLC
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to solve the imbalance and overload of electricity grid caused by starting multiple Resistance Welder Machines, the text puts forward a solution of having batch and time-sharing control over Resistance Welder Machines by means of Programmable Controller (PLC). This solution increases the stability and flexibility of control. In addition, the system hardware design and software process are also introduced.

articleTitle: The Virtual Experiment Design of Arithmetic Unit Based on Object-Oriented Technology
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In order to improve the effect of experimental teaching of the course “computer organization principle”, a design method of “computer organization principle” virtual experiment based upon object-oriented idea is put forward, in which the virtual experiment of ALU part is designed and debugged. Utilizing VC++ and Photoshop, arithmetic unit experiment in Tec-xp of the course computer organization principle is realized simulately, and the function of Am2901 is validated in the experiment. The result displays dynamic and in real-time effect, which acts just the same as the real hardware equipment. The virtual platform provides the students their own experimental environment freely, and a practical way for virtual experiment of computer hardware courses is supplied in the paper.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Strategy to University Internet Moral Education
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: With the changes brought by the internet to people's way of life, Internet moral education has been more and more important in university moral education. This paper narrates current situation of university internet moral education, and proposes approaches to its validity.

articleTitle: Study on Real-time Video Monitoring System Based on BSP-16
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The BSP-16 processors have the strong hardware structure and the software system. Adopting the BSP-16 processors suit to real-time Video Monitoring System. This text introduced the video coding principle, H.264 and real-time video monitoring system base on BSP-16.

articleTitle: Controlled Study on Video-Based Capture and Virtualization of Body Motion in Athletic Sports
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: For the complexity of the body movements in the videos of the athletic sports, the new video-based capture method is proposed, and it overcomes the errors when the body parts are obscured and the body joints do not meet the physical restraint system of the body. Compared with the other body motion capture techniques, it is low in cost, targeted and easy to implement. In terms of the design and modification of the virtual men, the paper puts forward the self-similar method based on the motion itself and the joint curve adjustment method based on the normal distribution.

articleTitle: Software Design and Application of a Combinatorial Algorithm on Safety Early-warning System for the Working Face in Mine
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Based on analyzing the contents of safety early-warning system for the working face in mine and according to the production characteristic of coal mine in China, combining the analytical hierarchy process and neural network BP algorithm. The safety early-warning system for the working face in mine was also designed based on the combinatorial algorithm. The system was applied to estimate support capacity and forecast the ground pressure of working surface in Xinan mine. The forecasting result proves that this method is very useful.

articleTitle: A Survey on Irregular Object Simulation
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper studies different kinds of methods on irregular object simulation, the methods applied mainly include the particle system method, the mathematic and physics-based method and the texture based method. Combining with the characteristic of each model, advantages and disadvantages of above methods, scope and effectiveness of the features were compared and the development of irregular objects' simulation is discussed.

articleTitle: Multimedia Technology Integration and Student Learning: Obstacle and Promise
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Political and institutional support has enabled many institutions of learning to spend millions of dollars to acquire educational multimedia tools that have not been effectively integrated into the curriculum. While access to educational technology tools has remarkably improved in most schools, there is still concern about instructional integration of multimedia technology to support student learning. Appropriate integration of multimedia tools constitutes a major change in people's lives; technology integration is a complex phenomenon that involves understanding teachers' motivations, perceptions, and beliefs about learning and technology. Although multimedia technology has a great potential to reform or even transform education, obstacle come in the way of achieving success especially with student learning. This paper presents an overview of technology use in education with a focus on obstacles to multimedia technology integration. Further, this paper provides suggestions to maximize the benefits of learning with multimedia technology.

articleTitle: Projection-Based Multi-angle Complex Wavelet Transform for Image Processing
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Image processing is widely used in many fields. Discrete Wavelet Transform is an useful tool in signal and image processing, but because of it's limit of coefficients reveal only three spatial orientations: horizontal, vertical, and diagonal, phase information cannot be collected fully. Projection-based complex wavelet transform works good in directional enhance with shift-insensitive and explicit phase information. It employed projection-based complex wavelet transform to do experiments for image dissection in every direction. The result shows the method works better in image dissection and image reconstruction completely.

articleTitle: The Analysis for the Attack on the Wireless Bridge Monitoring System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Wireless sensor network technology, through a large number of sensors to collect environmental factors, and then return the information through a wireless network to the back-end server-based computing. Bridge Monitoring in the field of civil engineering bridge which is used to observe whether the damage to the most effective way, at this stage mainly manpower to the scene to set the main instrument observations. In this study into wireless sensor system through the wireless sensors, effectively reduce the labor costs, and through the camera in a situation of start, with 3G mobile phone system return message to the monitoring personnel files. In this study, NS2 simulation experiment to simulate a wireless sensor network file if the transfer to the gateway node. Finally because the remote areas, the node may be due to denial of service attacks suffered external damage or the node for the node after the detour of damage with the attack used by the different queue management model, to simulate the queue with the analysis of the various attack packet loss under normal circumstances.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agent Simulation of Intelligence Reconnaissance Warfare
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: To support the advanced concept technology demonstration of operational applications of intelligence reconnaissance system (IRS) on future information battlefield, multi-agent simulation technology is applied in this paper. On the basis of analysis on intelligence processing and modeling process of intelligence reconnaissance warfare (IRW), a role-agent mapping mechanism is presented to set up the mappings from IRS's members to entity agents. Task-tree decomposition approach and task allocation are used to study multi-agent interactions in IRW model. The demonstration system shows that our model can identify main components in IRS and discover their local interactions and behaviors, which acts as the developer's window to dynamic, complex and intelligent IRW.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on Improving College Students' Linguistic Abilities through NEIE Learning System Based on CAI
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper intends to investigate into the effect of New Era Interactive English (NEIE) learning system on improving non-English majors' listening and speaking abilities and their attitude towards it. Both qualitative and quantitative research methods are used to analyze the results. Statistics show that the NEIE learning system is sure to improve students' listening and speaking abilities, some limitations are also summarized and implications gained, which are expected to be beneficial to the future reform in College English teaching and learning in China.

articleTitle: Methods of the Volume Measurement of Reservoir using GIS: Research & Practice
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The paper introduces methods and operation mode of measuring reservoir volume, building database, compiling volume tables and creating volume graphs by using modern measurement methods such as GPS, GIS and so on. It also generalizes the problems during practices and gives the methods and measures dealing with these problems.

articleTitle: Based on BP Neural Network Comprehensive Evaluation of College Educational Management System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The paper establishes a comprehensive evaluation index system of the college educational management system, and then based on neural network theory, constructs a comprehensive evaluation model of college educational management system based on BP neural network. The empirical analysis shows that the results of the evaluation model are reasonable, and the model is simple and has good application value.

articleTitle: Reservation of High-frequency Characteristics Based License Plate Detection
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The vehicle license plate detection is challenging first step in license plate recognition system. The license plate region is in the characteristics of gradient and frequent changes. This paper proposes High-pass filter to extract the gradient and frequent changes regions. Then merge adjacent regions as license plate candidates. Combined with the geometric features of license plates and the ratio of regional objectives in the background to find the license plate location, adopted the projection methods to remove the license plate frame, to achieve the exact position of license plate. Computer simulation results show that the proposed method of location has high accuracy.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of Multi- dimensional Wavelets Using Gröbner Basis
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: The problem of Construction and Application of Multi-dimensional Wavelets is studied. Using the concept of Gröbner basis and the algorithms of syzygy module in computing algebra, we design the symmetry-orthogonality multi-band multi-dimensional filter banks. Moreover, the expression of multi-scale function is achieved, which is used to construct multi- dimensional wavelets by multidimensional filter banks. Finally a orthogonal 2D wavelets which is Constructed in the paper is used to a remote sensing image coding. Experimental results show that it is much better coding performance.

articleTitle: Analysis on the Application of Multimedia Technology in Business Administration Professional Courses
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Directing at the characteristics of the basic professional course and teaching object for business management, this paper discusses the characteristics of the "management psychology", "marketing", "e-commerce" and other multimedia courseware, points out that application of multimedia in the professional courses of business management is in line with people's learning and cognitive rules, it can greatly improve the teaching efficiency, and is an important way to Teaching Reform of Business Management Course in the Information Age. Then it analyzes the unique role played by media, while, if not the rational use of the results will be counterproductive, specifies the application of multimedia technology in this field, the errors and, based on this puts forward the direction of improvements.

articleTitle: Apache Struts Applied for Construction of SMS Collection System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Struts has advantages of the view and business logic separated, and increases reusability and flexibility of the code for Web development. The SMS of mobile phone has advantages of low-cost communications, bi-directional transmission, reliable communication performance, and speed etc., make more and more people use it. The SMS Collection system can manage all SMS, to construct the system, the Struts framework is used, and makes the system has features of high scalability, distribution with high transparency, high modularization and reusability.

articleTitle: Research and Design of Sports CAD Training System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: This paper has made a research on the design of sports CAD training software system from the perspective of athletics training methodology and the regeneration of sports training knowledge. On this basis, this paper has built an object-oriented design model of sports CAD training system, and presented a general design method of this system, which has laid a methodological basis for this system's research and development work, and offered some referential significance for the research of CAD system in other fields.

articleTitle: The Optimal Clustering Algorithm for Image Organization and Management in Wireless Mobile Internet
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: In modern multimedia applications, images are often organized and managed by web sites or local applications with geographic information like GPS. But now this kind of multimedia applications doesn't come up in mobile communication environment. This paper proposes a method in image organization and sharing on mobile terminal whose resources are limited. We use the K-means clustering algorithm and its optimized algorithm to accomplish the image organization with geographic information. The application is based on C/S architecture under mobile environment. By comparing the optimized K-means algorithm with the original one, we get the conclusion that the optimized algorithm achieves a much better partition of the images. The demo mentioned at the end of the paper has validated the feasibility and advantages of this scheme.

articleTitle: The Positive Analysis of Industrial Structure Evolvement and Internationalized Operation of Chinese Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: According to the specific conditions of China's economic development, this thesis utilizes the statistical model to analyze the influence which enterprises' internationalized operation exerts on industrial structure evolvement. In conclusion, under the circumstances of economic globalization, economic restructuring and the change in the main source of economic growth, enterprises in China must adopt internationalized operation to reach the goal of optimizing industrial structure, improving the economic growth mode and completing the project of new industrialization.

articleTitle: The Research of Comparing PerformancePoint Server and Microsoft other BI Products
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Business intelligence is a powerful tool, it can help and guide enterprise to make decision, but improves their products and services quantity. This paper describes the functions of Performance Point Server and Microsoft other BI products, discusses their features, and finally, compares their management capabilities: monitoring, analysis, planning, and reporting.

articleTitle: An Improved Private Information Keeper System
publicationTitle: 2010 Second International Conference on Multimedia and Information Technology
abstract: Currently, people finds that there are more and more important accounts need to remember. It is a serious problem that how to make their private accounts information in safe keeping, because the leaked usernames and passwords always cause great trouble for the owner. In this paper, we will improve a proposed system previously for keeping more kinds of digital private information in safe. The methodology of proposed system keeps information in a kind of invisible state via steganography techniques. The proposed system is based on spatial domain techniques.
